title: Ammus bungalow
description:
From an empty plot to a complete home.
This bungalow in Bhuigaon, Vasai West was envisioned and developed as a complete end-to-end residential project. Every aspect of the property - from the structure and façade to the interiors and furnishings - was planned to create a warm, spacious and practical family home.

The pitched-roof architecture, large windows, detailed exterior finishes and generous entrance porch give the bungalow a distinctive character, while the interiors bring in a more contemporary feel through custom woodwork, layered lighting, comfortable furniture and carefully selected finishes.

A complete home, built from scratch with attention to both functionality and aesthetics.
